name: Binance Bridge
rootCause: Over half a billion stolen from the BNB bridge. If a chain can be stopped and started at a moment's notice, can it really be considered decentralised? Another bridge exploit, another entry on the leaderboard...

descriptions.text: Over half a billion stolen from the BNB bridge. If a chain can be stopped and started at a moment's notice, can it really be considered decentralised? Another bridge exploit, another entry on the leaderboard...

On October 6, 2022, an attacker exploited the BNB Chain bridge by forging IAVL Merkle proofs, enabling unauthorized minting of 2 million BNB. Vigilant chain pausing and address blacklisting preserved most funds; estimated net loss is near $100 million. A logic flaw in the IAVL Merkle proof verifier used by BSC Token Hub allowed the attacker to forge inclusion proofs. The bridge accepted these, minting BNB for unbacked, unauthorized payloads.
